issue.title: 🧑‍🌾  `test_allocator_memory_strategy` failing in Rolling Connext CI
issue.body:
### Generated by Generative AI

_No response_

### Operating System:

Ubuntu 24.04

### ROS version or commit hash:

rolling

### RMW implementation (if applicable):

rmw_connextdds

### RMW Configuration (if applicable):

_No response_

### Client library (if applicable):

rclcpp

### 'ros2 doctor --report' output

_No response_

### Steps to reproduce issue

1. Run a build in Rci Connext
2. See test regression fail


### Expected behavior

Test should pass

### Actual behavior

Test is failing flaky

### Additional information

Reference build:
- [Rci__nightly-connext_ubuntu_noble_amd64#587](http://build.ros2.org/job/Rci__nightly-connext_ubuntu_noble_amd64/587)

Test regression:
- [rclcpp.test_allocator_memory_strategy.gtest.missing_result](https://build.ros2.org/job/Rci__nightly-connext_ubuntu_noble_amd64/587/testReport/junit/(root)/rclcpp/test_allocator_memory_strategy_gtest_missing_result/)

Log output:
```
18: [ RUN      ] TestAllocatorMemoryStrategy.get_next_waitable
18: -- run_test.py: return code -11
18: -- run_test.py: generate result file '/tmp/ws/test_results/rclcpp/test_allocator_memory_strategy.gtest.xml' with failed test
18: -- run_test.py: verify result file '/tmp/ws/test_results/rclcpp/test_allocator_memory_strategy.gtest.xml'
 18/122 Test  #18: test_allocator_memory_strategy .........................***Failed    3.60 sec
```

Flakyness last 15 days:
job_name|last_fail|first_fail|build_count|failure_count|failure_percentage
-- | -- | -- | -- | -- | --
Rci__nightly-connext_ubuntu_noble_amd64|2025-11-10|2025-10-27|14|10|71.43


The only change that was introduced to rclcpp from the [first time it happened](https://build.ros2.org/job/Rci__nightly-connext_ubuntu_noble_amd64/550/) was: `https://github.com/ros2/rclcpp/pull/2952`, but it doesn't seem related to the problem.

```diff
   ros2/rclcpp:
     type: git
     url: https://github.com/ros2/rclcpp.git
-    version: cd9099d85be4619878af0f47f616270448d857e2
+    version: 715a983c9fe31497317bc4545625d13a0142553e
```

CC: @miguelgonrod
